source.title: Tomorrow's plans (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled Hindi. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Hindi written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing, wrong agreement or wrong spelling. The English lines are the drafter’s own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: First future-tense unit (-ऊँगा / -ऊँगी / -एगा / -एँगे / -ओगे). रवि सर and मीरा दीदी use आप to Sam and तुम to Aman; Aman says तुम-forms never to adults. "अगले हफ़्ते" is the oblique of अगला before a noun. "छुट्टी" is used for Ravi sir's day off and the school holiday. The word आदमी/औरत pair recycles the church unit. Words outside the plan (measured, adapter lemmas x tokens): बारिश×2, तब×1 (under-met).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Hello, sir. Hello, didi.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: Hello, Sam! Come in, have some tea.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Thank you, sir.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: सैम, कल आपकी क्या योजना है?
sentences.english: Sam, what is your plan for tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Tomorrow I will stay at home.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Perhaps I will do a little work.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: I will go to the market tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: Aman will come with me too.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: Yes! Tomorrow I will go to the market!

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.text: मुझे कल स्कूल नहीं जाना है।
sentences.english: I do not have to go to school tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: Tomorrow is a holiday.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: I do not have a holiday.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Tomorrow morning I will go to the hospital.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: I have a lot of work there.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Will you come home tomorrow evening?

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Yes, I will come in the evening.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Sir, shall I come too?

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: Yes, please do come.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I will wake up early in the morning.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: I will wake up too!

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: अमन, तुम तो रोज़ देर से जागते हो!
sentences.english: Aman, you always wake up late!

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: Tomorrow I will surely get up early.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: अच्छा। कल का दिन अच्छा होगा।
sentences.english: Good. Tomorrow will be a good day.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: And the day after tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: परसों रविवार है। हम गिरजा जाएँगे।
sentences.english: The day after tomorrow is Sunday. We will go to church.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: The day after tomorrow there is a meeting at church.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Pastor Anil will pray.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: And there will be a song too!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I like the hymn.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: The worship will be very good.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Everyone will say "Amen".

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: The pastor will give everyone a blessing.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Will all the women and men come?

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Yes, many people will come.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: And next week?

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: अगले हफ़्ते स्कूल की छुट्टी है।
sentences.english: Next week there is a school holiday.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: We will go to the village by train.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: ट्रेन सुबह नौ बजे आती है।
sentences.english: The train comes at nine in the morning.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I will prepare for the meeting.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: आज का दिन भी अच्छा है।
sentences.english: Today is a good day too.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.text: ट्रेन से! मैं बहुत ख़ुश हूँ।
sentences.english: By train! I am very happy.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: I will have time too.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: अगले हफ़्ते की तैयारी कौन करेगा?
sentences.english: Who will make the preparations for next week?

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: We will all prepare.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: सैम, क्या आपके पास समय है?
sentences.english: Sam, do you have time?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: हाँ, मेरे पास बहुत समय है।
sentences.english: Yes, I have plenty of time.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: अच्छा। कल शाम हम योजना बनाएँगे।
sentences.english: Good. Tomorrow evening we will make a plan.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: That is a good plan.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Sir, what will we buy tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: हम आलू, प्याज़ और केला लेंगे।
sentences.english: We will buy potatoes, onions and bananas.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Nani will make roti and vegetables.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.text: मैं भी नानी के साथ रसोई में रहूँगा!
sentences.english: I will be in the kitchen with Nani too!

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: अमन, तुम रसोई में नहीं रहते!
sentences.english: Aman, you never stay in the kitchen!

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.text: कल मैं रहूँगा। मुझे चावल पसंद है।
sentences.english: Tomorrow I will. I like rice.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: और मैदान में तुम गेंद से खेलोगे।
sentences.english: And in the field you will play with the ball.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: Yes! Will Sam play too?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I will take pictures, Aman.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Perhaps I will play too.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Do play, Sam.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: जब सैम खेलेगा, अमन बहुत ख़ुश होगा!
sentences.english: When Sam plays, Aman will be very happy!

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: Yes, I will be very happy!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Will it rain tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: शायद। जब बारिश होगी, तब हम घर में रहेंगे।
sentences.english: Perhaps. When it rains, we will stay at home.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: There will be water in the lane.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.text: मोहल्ले में बहुत पानी होता है।
sentences.english: There is a lot of water in the neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: लेकिन हम पुल के सामने से जाएँगे।
sentences.english: But we will go past the front of the bridge.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.text: और बाज़ार में हम आधा किलो आम लेंगे!
sentences.english: And at the market we will buy half a kilo of mangoes!

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: All right, Aman.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Sam, will you have more tea?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: नहीं, दीदी, धन्यवाद। मैं अब घर जाऊँगा।
sentences.english: No, didi, thank you. I will go home now.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: Nani will make food for you.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: हाँ, नानी रोटी और दाल बनाएँगी।
sentences.english: Yes, Nani will make roti and dal.

sentences.speaker: aman
sentences.english: And I will drink milk.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: And I will drink tea.

sentences.speaker: meera
sentences.english: I will drink water.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Tomorrow everything will be fine.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.text: सैम, यह मेरा मोबाइल नंबर है।
sentences.english: Sam, this is my mobile number.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: धन्यवाद, सर। मैं कल आपसे मिलूँगा।
sentences.english: Thank you, sir. I will meet you tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: ravi
sentences.english: We will meet at the market.
